svg.title: SafarSetu architecture
svg.desc: The web dashboard and mobile app call an Express API over REST and server-sent events. The API and the mobile app both use the shared pure-TypeScript core package, which holds the router, planner, alerts and impact model. The API reads timetable data and stores plans, reports and notifications.
